title: Conductor Kernel Workflow State
description: Base schema for workflow-mode kernel state files. Domain plugins extend via domain_extensions. Backward compatible with conductor-plugin/schemas/conductor-state.schema.json v2.0.0 — all v2 files validate against v3 because the new fields (domain, domain_extensions, schema_version=3.0) are optional with sensible defaults.
$comment_required: Required list intentionally empty per reconciliation 2026-05-19. Prior list (project_name, current_phase, current_step, task_queue, completed_tasks, verification_status) was aspirational — survey of 29 live state files showed 14/29 missing one or more of these fields at any given time, including completed workflows (no task_queue), early-phase workflows (no current_step), and recovery-session files (no project_name). Schema documents structure of declared fields when present; it does not enforce phase-dependent presence.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Kernel v0.1.0 publishes this schema at 3.0. Absence defaults to 2.0 (legacy conductor-plugin file) and the reader injects domain='dev' and domain_extensions={} at load time. Versions '1.0'/'1.0.0' are accepted as the in-flight live conductor-state.json variant and load without modification per REQ-CDV-002.

domain.description: Domain plugin identifier. Used to select tier-matrix weights, state-schema extensions, tools-allowlist. Absence defaults to 'dev' for backward compatibility with conductor-plugin state files.

project_name.description: Name of the project being orchestrated

project_description.description: Free-text description of the project. Used by tier classifier and BRD extractor.

brd_source.description: Path or URI to the source BRD/PRD document if one exists.

initiated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when orchestration started. Optional in v3; required in v2 — readers tolerate absence.

session_started_at.description: Alternate field name used by some legacy files. Treated as synonym for initiated_at.

last_updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last state write.

working_directory.description: Absolute path to the working directory where state file lives.

tier.description: Tier classification result. CRITICAL added in v3 to support CLUE alert classification.

tier_classification.description: Full tier classification record per REQ-KER-006. signals + weights are domain-supplied; only the structure is enforced here.

signals.description: Domain-specific 5-signal scores. Dev domain uses {scope,type,risk,ambiguity,intent_sensitivity}; SOC domain uses {impact,scope,confidence,data_classification,reversibility}.

weights.description: Per-signal weights summing to 1.0. Loaded from the domain's tier-matrix.yaml.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation of why this score was assigned.

classified_at.description: Legacy v1.0 field — when classification was performed. REQ-CDV-002.

rescoped_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent operator-driven tier re-classification.

rescope_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the rescope, captured at rescope time.

tier_override.description: Operator override indicator. Canonically boolean, but legacy state files store override rationale here as a string (e.g., 'MAJOR (user-specified)', 'operator_requested'). Accept both forms.

gate_mode.description: Default gate mode for critic checkpoints; per-tier matrix.

oneOf.description: Canonical phase record. Reconciliation 2026-05-19: dropped required [number,name] and additional-property restrictions — many in-flight files write partial records.
Shorthand phase identifier (e.g., 'phase_4_verification', 'phase1_complete') used by some legacy state files.
Bare phase index used by some legacy state files.
Free-text description of the current step. Legacy form used by conductor-plugin state files.

Reconciliation 2026-05-19: relaxed from required [number,name,status] — many in-flight state files write partial step records (e.g., only {name, status}). Status enum extended to include workflow-specific terminal markers like 'closing-arc-complete'.
Legacy v1.0 task shape: {id, description, agent, status}. REQ-CDV-002.

completed_tasks.description: Completed task history. Item shape is intentionally permissive — agents (including kernel agents like analyze-codebase) write varied records. Items may be plain string descriptions/IDs (e.g., 'README + Obsidian documentation', 'phase-4-prep-oi-26-zero-failure-baseline-restored'), v1 {step,name,agent,completed_at,outcome,deliverables,duration_minutes}, brownfield analysis {id,description,agent,deliverable,files_read,completed_at,surprises}, or other shapes. Validation is structural only; consumers must tolerate shape variation.

failed_tasks.description: Dead letter queue. Reference v2 conductor-state schema for full structure.

agents_invoked.description: Agents invoked in this workflow. Items may be qualified <plugin>:<agent> strings or rich invocation records ({agent, task_id, dispatched_at, completed_at, verdict, deliverables_summary, ...}). Consumers must tolerate both forms.

verification_status.description: Verification gate states. Property names are gate identifiers (e.g., post_architect, post_ciso, post_qa, post_implementation, post_pentest, post_supply_chain, pre_release, completeness_validation). Reconciliation 2026-05-19: enum relaxed to free-form string after survey of 29 state files found long-tail values that did not fit the original enum (e.g., 'skip', 'not_applicable', 'pass-353-tests-mypy-clean', plus ISO-date values used by completeness_validation_date sibling keys). Canonical values remain pass/fail/pending/advisory_pass_with_findings/skipped/aligned/drift/ambiguous/in_progress/completed/approved/approved_with_conditions/needs_rework/block/pass_with_notes; consumers should treat unrecognized strings as advisory.

gemini_validations.description: Gemini validation results per REQ-KER-016. See v2 schema for full per-entry structure. Hermes E3 (REQ-CDV-HERMES-012) adds an optional flat `dispatch_mode` field to each item documenting whether the dispatch used the Task tool or mcp__MCP_DOCKER__code-mode.

dispatch_mode.description: Hermes E3 (REQ-CDV-HERMES-012): dispatch transport for this agent invocation. Flat sibling — NOT nested under .entry. The kernel schema is permissive (open items), so this documentation is non-breaking for consumers that omit the field.

change_log.description: Hermes E6 — per-tool-call attribution log metadata (REQ-CDV-HERMES-001/002)

entries_count.description: Total entries appended to active log this workflow

code_mode_latency.description: Hermes E3 (REQ-CDV-HERMES-015): paired latency measurements between task-mode baseline and code-mode actual runs for the same fan-out template. Top-level sibling to gemini_validations, change_log. Additive — backward compatible. After >=10 paired runs, mean(ratio) must be >=0.30 or feature_flags.code_mode_enabled stays false. Moved from properties.metrics.properties.code_mode_latency to top-level per Gemini E3 validation 2026-05-20.

task_mode_baseline_ms.description: Latency of the same fan-out via task mode.

code_mode_actual_ms.description: Latency of the same fan-out via code-mode.

spec_alignment.description: Spec alignment check result. Null until run.

builder_readback.description: Builder readback verification result. Null until builder reads back.

remediation_loops.description: Loop counter (integer) in canonical form. Some legacy files store a log array of remediation loop records instead; both accepted.

critic_rejections.description: Alias for total_critic_rejections used in some legacy state files. Counter (integer) in canonical form; some files store a log array of rejection records.

recovery.description: Recovery state from kernel.recovery_classify per REQ-KER-020.

agent_instances.description: Non-Human Identity registry per governance-plugin manifest.

circuit_breaker.description: Circuit breaker state for external integrations.

governance.description: Governance framework state. Required fields enforced by governance-plugin, not by kernel.

agent_card_validations.description: Audit log of agent card validation outcomes.

audit_sink.description: External audit trail configuration. Domain plugins may add transports.

cost_tracking.description: Token and cost tracking for denial-of-wallet protection.

token_budget.description: Token budget tracking by phase and by model. Alternate naming used by clue2 state files; treated as synonym of cost_tracking for read purposes.

project_characteristics.description: Detected project characteristics for capability enforcement.

ku_ki_extraction.description: KU/KI keyword extraction state from retrospective.

project_signature.description: Per-project behavioral signature accumulated across workflows.

code_directories.description: Map of logical name to absolute path for repos referenced by this workflow.

infrastructure.description: Map of logical name to URL/host for infrastructure dependencies.

phases_planned.description: Map of phase number/name to summary.

phasing.description: Workflow phasing plan per conductor-dev hermes-inspired enhancements. Maps phase identifiers (P1, P2, ...) to phase records with name, enhancements list, status, optional blocked_by, and order.

feature_flags.description: Per-project boolean feature flags. Open-ended map; specific flag semantics owned by the consuming agent or workflow (e.g., code_mode_enabled).

constraints.description: Load-bearing constraints. Free-form to allow domain-specific structure.

constraints_load_bearing.description: Flat-list form of load-bearing constraints used by clue2 state.

is_brownfield.description: Legacy v1.0 field — indicates project is a brownfield analysis target. Preserved for REQ-CDV-002 backward-compat with conductor-plugin state files.

open_questions_resolved.description: Legacy v1.0 field — resolved open questions. Some files use array of records, others use object map keyed by question_id. REQ-CDV-002.

phase_1_complete.description: Legacy v1.0 field — phase 1 completion flag. REQ-CDV-002.

phase_1_deliverable.description: Legacy v1.0 field — phase 1 deliverable summary. REQ-CDV-002.

phase_2_started_at.description: Legacy v1.0 field — phase 2 start timestamp. REQ-CDV-002.

phase_history.description: Legacy v1.0 field — full phase progression history. REQ-CDV-002.

project_root.description: Legacy v1.0 field — absolute path to project root. Treated as synonym of working_directory. REQ-CDV-002.

started_at.description: Legacy v1.0 field — workflow start timestamp. Treated as synonym of initiated_at. REQ-CDV-002.

user_directive.description: Legacy v1.0 field — captured user directive at workflow start. REQ-CDV-002.

domain_extensions.description: Extension point per REQ-KER-003. Domain plugins write arbitrary structure here. Kernel never reads or writes these fields. Example for SOC: {investigation_id, alert_ids, evidence_chain, mitre_techniques, disposition, confidence, verdict_narrative, containment_actions, after_action_observations}. Reconciliation 2026-05-19 relaxed root additionalProperties to true, so this is no longer the sole extension point — but it remains the recommended location for domain-plugin extensions.

updated_at.description: Reconciliation Camp A: most-recent write timestamp. Common across conductor-dev/plugin-cache state files.

created_at.description: Reconciliation Camp A: workflow creation timestamp. Treat as alias of initiated_at where present.

tier_score.description: Reconciliation Camp A: flattened tier score (1.0-4.0). Some state files store this alongside or instead of tier_classification.score.

tier_signals.description: Reconciliation Camp A: flattened tier signal scores. Mirrors tier_classification.signals shape but accepts either bare numbers (1-4) or rich signal records {value, weight, rationale}.

tier_rationale.description: Reconciliation Camp A: flattened human-readable rationale for the tier score. Mirrors tier_classification.rationale.

workflow_type.description: Reconciliation Camp A: high-level workflow kind. Observed values: new, existing, brd-provided, ui-heavy.

workflow_status.description: Reconciliation Camp A: rollup workflow status.

workflow_complete.description: Reconciliation Camp A: terminal workflow-complete flag set by PPT2Vid-style state files.

workflow_complete_at.description: Reconciliation Camp A: timestamp of workflow_complete=true transition.

workflow_completed_at.description: Reconciliation Camp A: synonym of workflow_complete_at observed in some files.

phases.description: Reconciliation Camp A: per-phase records. Some files store array of phase records; others store an object map (numeric or symbolic keys like 'phase_0_analysis', 'PHASE_1_DATABASE', '0', '1'). Both forms accepted.

phases_completed.description: Reconciliation Camp A: array of completed phase identifiers (string names or numbers).

completed_phases.description: Reconciliation Camp A: synonym of phases_completed used in some files. Items intentionally permissive.

previous_phases.description: Reconciliation Camp A: prior-phase records carried forward across recovery sessions.

adversarialReview.description: Reconciliation Camp A: camelCase variant of adversarial_review present in legacy state files.

prd_source.description: Reconciliation Camp A: path or identifier of the PRD/spec the workflow was bootstrapped from.

prd_path.description: Reconciliation Camp A: filesystem path of the PRD document.

spec_path.description: Reconciliation Camp A: filesystem path of the architecture/spec document.

verification_gates.description: Reconciliation Camp A: per-gate verification record (e.g., phase_0_brownfield, phase_1_brd_critic, phase_2_architect_gemini). Distinct from verification_status which is the rollup map.

status.description: Reconciliation Camp A: rollup status. Synonym of workflow_status in many files; both accepted.

decisions.description: Reconciliation Camp A: open/resolved decisions captured during the workflow. Either object map of decision-id → record, or array of decision objects.

gates.description: Reconciliation Camp A: per-critic gate state (architecture_critic, brd_critic, implementation_critic, pre_release_critic, spec_critic, post_pentest_critic, etc.).

kernel_version.description: Reconciliation Camp A: kernel version that wrote this state file.

state_signature.description: Optional HMAC over the state file contents using a kernel-managed key, computed by kernel.workflow.state_advance per RC for F-08. Readers SHOULD verify the signature where present; absent or invalid signature on a state file claimed to be state_advance-managed = corrupted, abort workflow.

skill_promotion.description: Hermes E1 — skill promotion candidates and history (REQ-CDV-HERMES-009/010/011). OPTIONAL block. Recorded by the retrospective agent's Section 4 mining and updated by skill-promote.sh / skill-promote-patch.sh on operator action.

candidates.description: Trajectory-pattern promotion candidates surfaced for operator review.

trajectory_ids.description: Qdrant trajectory IDs that contributed to this candidate (>=3 per the §3.6 hard limit).

proposed_skill_path.description: Filesystem path of the drafted SKILL.md under ~/.claude/skills/_proposed/<slug>/

success_count.description: Number of outcome.success trajectories matching the pattern in the 90-day window.

trajectory_pattern_hash.description: SHA-256 of the pipe-joined execution_trace[].tool sequence.

patches.description: Skill self-improvement patch candidates surfaced from change-log re-edit analysis.

target_skill.description: Slug of the skill the patch targets (matches ~/.claude/skills/<slug>/).

patch_path.description: Filesystem path of the unified diff under ~/.claude/skills/_patches/

re_edit_clusters.description: Number of <5min edit clusters detected in the 90-day window.

$comment: Reconciliation 2026-05-19: root additionalProperties reverted from false (RC-13/F-18) back to true. Survey of 29 live state files showed kernel-owned agents (analyze-codebase, gemini-validator) writing root-level project-specific fields the strict-root rule never accommodated. Camp A high-frequency fields (updated_at, created_at, tier_score, tier_signals, workflow_type, phases, adversarialReview, prd_source, prd_path, verification_gates, phases_completed, status, decisions, gates) are now declared properties with subschemas — those get validated. Other project-specific extras are accepted but unvalidated. The domain_extensions escape hatch remains for forward-compatible additions.
